highlights_headline: The next SkiaSharp 4.157.0 update improves mask-filtered glyph rendering when successive font-scaler loads disagree.

bullets.lead: Handle changing glyph paths and mask layouts
bullets.detail: Mask-filtered glyph rendering uses the reloaded glyph's own outline or raster image. Incompatible formats and non-overlapping bounds produce cleared output instead of unsafe copies or format assertions. Clipped embossed glyphs retain full plane strides, and clearing the full destination prevents leftover mask data.
